purpose: failure mechanisms are the highest-value distillation output; each entry states WHAT failed and WHY

github.finding: OOS IC 0.473; gross +$1,475,656; cost $13,111,643; net -$11,635,987; net Sharpe -0.733; edge 9.11bps vs 10.3bps round trip.
github.why: the signal is inside-spread reversion: dropping reversion features collapses IC 0.473 -> 0.177 (maker's edge, not a taker's).
github.v3_action: V3: publish a per-symbol cost hurdle and screen every candidate against it BEFORE any backtest.

github.finding: +0.29 tick mean signed midpoint move vs 1.08 tick entry+exit spread cost: negative at every valid delay and horizon (median -1.00 tick).
github.why: the directional information is real but smaller than the cost of crossing to act on it.
github.v3_action: V3: measure execution-state value inside the decision, not as a standalone crossing signal.

github.finding: round trip ~9-11c on a 40-50c contract (10.7c break-even); longshots bought at the ask lose 3.1c (t=-8.9); passive maker -$913 over 14,690 fills.
github.why: inefficient at the mid, efficient at the touch.
github.v3_action: V3: compute the break-even adverse move per symbol; test mid AND touch.

github.finding: passive fills depend on uncalibrated parameters: rho (fraction of a level drop assumed ahead of you), pro-rata cancel apportionment, queue_ahead estimand.
github.why: the fraction of a level-size drop that was ahead of you is unidentifiable without ground-truth cancels/hidden orders.
github.v3_action: V3: treat fills as a SENSITIVITY BAND and publish the sweep; never a point estimate.

github.finding: 36 real-tick parameter passes on XAUUSD M1 all land at expected payoff ~-0.31/trade (range -0.307462..-0.316822), PF 0.209-0.230, trades 1,049->5,073.
github.why: filters change HOW MANY trades you take, never WHAT A TRADE IS WORTH => pure cost, no alpha to tune.
github.v3_action: V3: adopt this as a mandatory acceptance test.

github.finding: same build/settings: generated ticks PF 1.97 / +252 vs real ticks PF 0.34 / -5,258; DD 0.13% vs 52.58% (5.8x).
github.why: generated-tick backtests systematically overstate XAUUSD tick strategies.
github.v3_action: V3: real-tick-only acceptance; publish the generated-vs-real delta.

github.finding: 'reducing adverse selection by an estimated 30%' comes from OFIValidator: a z-score-only, engine-free, direction-only toy that defines AS as |realized loss| on synthetic data.
github.why: the headline number is not markout, not passive, and not executed.
github.v3_action: V3: verify every headline against the code that produced it; require a mechanism-matched metric.

github.finding: AS is injected as a post-fill drift (informed_impact); the README states there is no real LOB, feed, queue or latency.
github.why: if you generate the adverse move you have not measured toxicity.
github.v3_action: V3: never accept an AS result from a simulator that injects the AS.

github.finding: bar-touch fills at exact SL/TP, SL checked before TP, commission 0.0003 relative, slippage 0.0001 - and NO spread cost at all, on ~18-minute gold scalps.
github.why: win rate is set by barrier geometry, not edge; the reported 77.3% / 4.43x return-DD is a simulator artifact.
github.v3_action: V3: bar-level results must be re-run on ticks before any gold scalp claim.

github.finding: A1's own source: 'Most retail brokers serve a synthetic DOM derived from their B-book pool ... DISABLE on retail accounts.' A6 records has_trade_flags because MT5 forex usually lacks aggressor flags.
github.why: retail MT5 gold order-flow inputs are inferred or synthetic.
github.v3_action: V3: validate DOM non-degeneracy and flag availability before any microstructure feature earns weight.

github.finding: cross-deployer namespace collision silently overwrote data; a collector printed '0 errors' while persisting nothing; a stale script 'reports a plausible number computed over in-sample and out-of-sample data pooled together'.
github.why: provenance failures are silent and produce plausible numbers.
github.v3_action: V3: hash-lock the IS/OOS split boundary and the cost schedule; assert the guard in CI.

github.finding: 4,701 clustered trigger events with overlapping windows => no CI implied; overlapping labels require purging; overlapping rebalancing counts the same move H times.
github.why: overlap inflates both PnL and turnover and invalidates naive t-stats.
github.v3_action: V3: purge, embargo, de-overlap, cluster errors before quoting any statistic.

github.finding: No Group-A repo demonstrates net-of-cost, out-of-sample, tick-level edge on XAUUSD.
github.why: the only execution-aware honest work concludes the scalping entry is an execution defect; profitability requires NOT scalping.
github.v3_action: V3: treat the XAUUSD tick-scalping route as evidence-backed unproductive.

github.finding: author: 'What is not verified: calibration of eta, gamma_p, A, k to any real market'; the AC model also omits the epsilon*X spread/fee term.
github.why: engineering rigor does not imply market validity.
github.v3_action: V3: require an explicit 'what is NOT verified' block and refuse uncalibrated parameters as forecasts.
